detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing in Musical Experience
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes research on the role of predictive processing in musical experience. By integrating the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis and active interoceptive inference accounts, we delineate how musical structures engage the brain's predictive machinery. The resulting notebook establishes a foundation for understanding how rhythmic and harmonic expectations modulate emotional valence.

detail.title: Predictive Processing and Musical Emotional Valence
detail.summary: Music acts as a complex temporal signal that engages the brain's predictive processing systems. This notebook explores how the interaction between auditory expectation, error signaling, and interoceptive inference generates emotional states.
detail.reason: Synthesizing these sources provides a structural explanation for the project's focus on musical predictive processing.
